warning: Evidence only; not migration SQL. Re-export and compare before baseline acceptance.

views.name: auto_offers
views.definition: SELECT id, name, kind, value, scope, target, min_total, starts, ends, cty FROM offers WHERE ((code IS NULL) AND active);

views.name: product_ratings
views.definition: SELECT product_id, (round(avg(rating), 1))::double precision AS avg, (count(*))::integer AS n FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id;

views.name: public_products
views.definition: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.col, p.price, p.old, p.stock, p.stocks, p.cty, p.code, p.img, p.images, p.descr, p.sizes, p.axes, p.chart, p.maker, p.maker_addr, p.origin, p.ships_from, p.sku, p.weight_g, p.dims, p.material, p.at, p.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.slug AS store_slug, s.logo_url AS store_logo FROM products p JOIN stores s ON s.id = p.store_id;

views.name: public_reviews
views.definition: SELECT id, product_id, rating, body, name, at FROM reviews;

views.name: public_stores
views.definition: SELECT id, slug, name, tagline, about, logo_url, cover_url, accent, categories, country, state, city, is_official, created_at FROM stores;

notes: All five observed public views use security_invoker=true.
Storage policy roles reported as PUBLIC are represented as [PUBLIC]; authenticated-only policies are listed explicitly.
Two sequences (audit_log_id_seq and ledger_entries_id_seq) have no OWNED BY dependency in the catalog; confirm their application usage before baseline recreation.
The media bucket is public-read, but uploads and mutations are constrained by storage.objects RLS policies; this snapshot does not imply public write access.
